title: National Venture Capital Guidance Fund
title_original: 国家创业投资引导基金
summary: Government venture fund launched on 26 December 2025, with three regional funds for Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta and the Greater Bay Area. A Ministry of Finance official said the state contributes 100 billion yuan at national level from ultra-long special treasury bonds. Social capital is invited at regional and sub-fund levels, and NDRC expects total funds of around 1 trillion yuan. The fund has a 20-year life, and sub-funds must put at least 70% into seed and early-stage firms. AI is one of several frontier sectors it targets, alongside biopharmaceuticals, quantum technology and 6G. It is not an AI-only fund.
purpose: Central fiscal capital for seed and early-stage investment in strategic emerging and frontier industries, AI among them.
